brewery.brewery_description:
On the shores of the great Lake Taupõ, tales abound of a mythical beer-drinking beast. He’s a big hairy bugger and the locals call him Lakeman.
But there’s something that sets him apart from other mythical beer-drinking beasts. Lakeman fancies craft beer, you see. And because you never want to get on the wrong side of such a creature, we created a brewery in his honour. It’s called Lakeman Brewing Co, and is fast becoming the stuff of legend around these parts. One taste and you’ll know why. Lakeman is brewed from Taupo’s purest natural water and boasts malty, hoppy flavours as big as the myth itself. So if you spot one, don’t be afraid. Just coax it gently to the nearest bar leaner, raise it to your lips and get it down you, you big hairy beast.

beer.beer_description: An amber New Zealand pale ale which bursts with the aromas of citrus and passionfruit. These fruit flavours strike a smooth malt followed by a mild bitterness that rumbles on.
A bold hop forward amber IPA with aromas of fresh summer fruit, citrus and a hint of pine. A smooth not shaggy balanced malt ends with a pop of citrus flavours.
A golden american pale ale with so many hops jam packed in sumpin's gotta give. This is a rodeo of stonefruit and citrus flavours with a mild malt sweetness so saddle up partner and say YEEHAH!
Get your opposable thumb around our crisp new world style pilsner. Straw in colour and of light malt character with lemon citrus notes and pacific jade hops providing a soft bitter finish.

Jumping for joy ‘cause it’s 5 O’clock somewhere! This juicy unfiltered IPA delivers citrus and stone fruit flavours on an light body. A highly sessionable drop to celebrate 5 O'Clock Somewhere! (or near enough). Hops - Zythos, Simcoe & Nelson Sauvin
An American amber ale with a clean smooth malt. Lashings of simcoe & zythos hops give a rush of grapefruit zest, pine & stonefruit flavours. Now that is one offer you cannot refuse.
ALL THE HOP PRESENCE OF A BIG BEER STARRING US HOP ELDORADO WITH TROPICAL FRUIT AND STONE FRUIT FLAVOURS ON A STRIPPED BACK MALT PRODUCING A FLAVOURSOME SESSIONABLE XPA.

beer.beer_style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
beer.beer_description: Throwing Caution to the hot desert wind agave juice has been used in the ferment to dry and temper the malt, so experimental hop NZH-102 can dominate with tropical fruit and blueberry notes. Small additions of mosaic, simcoe and nelson sauvin complement in the production of this big juicy hazy.
Music in a can, Purple Haze all around, put a spell on you, se-juice your mind. This is a big juice bomb of stone fruit which will hit the spot for all those lovers of Hazy’s.

A full bodied stout with roasted barley and chocolate malts aged on American Oak Chips. Additions of raisins add a mild sweetness & Rum imparts spice & warmth. Different flavour layers give a smooth complexity.
Sundowner is a little gem with its creamy body dominated by stone fruit and tropical flavours

Get your mojo on with this swinging golden IPA. Upfront bitterness with yeah baby notes of berry, stonefruit and gooseberry countered with secret agent NZ hop 4337 imparting some luscious tropical notes. Get in my belly.
Full bodied stout with an  enveloping warmth from an oak whisky blend infused with cold press Tahitian vanilla extract and a trace of mocha.

beer.beer_style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
beer.beer_description: A juicy double hazy packed with Cryo Sabro, Cryo Talus, Citra and Nelson Sauvin. These hops unite in a glorious flavour profile of coconut, mango, peach, citrus and grape.
Lakeman loves a hoppy ending and he hopes this may give you one with heady aromas and flavours of stone fruit and tropical fruit.

Don’t be fooled this no adjunct stout has real
depth with decadent roast malt flavours and a malt bitterness that carries throughout finishing with a note of cold-brewed coffee.
Mornin’ Glory has a fresh, zesty hit of citrus up front followed by sweeter mango notes.

Brewed by a couple of yokels in the hills of Taupo.
Put down your banjo and try this precious little oat
cream hazy with notes of sweet lime, mango and
lychee.

This hero of a Double IPA is ready to confront any foe with power and might.  A big hitter with power notes of citrus and apricot,  Dragon Slayer cuts through the chaos with great dankness.  This is a smooth, stealth-like hunter you will not see coming.

This brutal hazy is going to make you want to head bang your way into oblivion. A balanced malt up front is pummelled by the epic tropical combo of Nectaron and Ekuanot and cooled by the melody of Nelson Sauvin.

West Coast IPA
upfront citrus followed by the tropical notes of pineapple, mango, and berry with a rowdy bitterness that will cradle your palate and leave your tastebuds ringing
Brimming with papaya, citrus and stone fruit
Symphony of tropical juiciness, coconut, tangerine and a hint of sauvignon blanc.

items.badge_description:
Hoppy Hazy IPA Day! 

For the uninitiated, Sierra Nevada had the brilliant idea to create a day of celebration for hazies back in 2023! This year, we’re excited to introduce our third iteration of the Hazy IPA Day badge. 

Whether you call it hazy, murky, blurry, or New England style, let’s raise our glasses to these heavenly hoppy ales!

Thanks for staying at home, and checking in with Untappd! It allows us to stay connected to a community of beer lovers, just like you, even if we can't be in the same physical location. From our home to yours, cheers and stay safe!
